confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Swiss restaurant prices are high by European standards, and July is peak season in Interlaken, so accommodation is the least certain group, especially the 1-star and 3-star hotel anchors. Drink anchors are direct estimates, not derived from the beer price. The RBA exchange-rate observation could not be verified in this session, so the fx fields are null. Do not convert the USD anchors until a verified RBA observation is supplied.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other Swiss Alpine resort towns (for example Lucerne, Grindelwald and Lauterbrunnen) at July high-season rates, adjusted for Interlaken's tourist-hub pricing.
